caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden clog positioned in a side view, showcasing its interior and the full profile of its exterior. The clog is rendered in shades of brown, with darker tones used for the outside and lighter, more yellowish-brown hues illustrating the inside surface. Various textures and lines on the clog suggest the grain and carved nature of the wood. The clog has a wide, hollowed opening at the top and a thick base that curves upward at the toe. The drawing is set against a plain, light beige background, with no other objects or decorative elements present. The artist's name and the date "Lloyd C. Lemcke 1937" are lightly inscribed below the clog.
title: Wooden Shoe
